message.content: Proposed 3 changes — review the inline preview, then Accept or Reject.

patch.title: 统一患者组命名：methods.tex 中首次（正文）出现缩写处改为标准格式 "treatment group (TG) / control group (CG)"；flow.tex 与 supplement.tex 在全称已定义后改回使用缩写 TG/CG；abstract.tex 保留首现全称（符合论文自述惯例）。

hunks.oldText: We call the treatment group TG and the control group CG after their first full names.
hunks.newText: We call the treatment group (TG) and the control group (CG) after their first full names.

hunks.oldText: The treatment group had 128 enrolled patients and the control group had 126.
hunks.newText: TG had 128 enrolled patients and CG had 126.

hunks.oldText: The treatment group and control group labels are used in the supplementary analysis.
hunks.newText: The TG and CG labels are used in the supplementary analysis.
